title: fix(app-shell): a related-record form the URL opens over a record drawer stays on top after a reload
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKuMF8vPAEKktMcUMbpCuFX)_

Fixes #32685

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从记录侧栏的相关列表点「新建」后刷新页面（或打开分享链接），新建表单现在总在侧栏之上；「创建」按钮可点，Esc 先关表单，与点击打开时一致。
- 为什么改：刷新时表单先挂载、侧栏晚一拍才打开，两者都是同层级的 body 浮层，后打开的盖住先打开的，表单右半边和「创建」被侧栏挡住，用户无法完成新建。
- 风险与回滚：只改 console 的 URL 表单何时打开（等路由页面显示、等它要画的侧栏画出），不改任何对外导出或元数据；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx`（`useRecordFormOpensOverDrawers` 与侧栏登记）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`（表单 `open` 与 `RouteSlotShown`）、新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：任意对象列表打开一条记录的侧栏，在相关列表点「新建」，然后刷新页面：表单在侧栏之上、「创建」可点，按 Esc 先关表单、侧栏留着。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）对照 diff 复核：表单等路由真正显示、且侧栏画出来以后才打开，打开后不会被后开的侧栏关掉；只改 app-shell 内部文件，不改公开出口，Clause-② no 成立。手机路径已请卡线程实测：手机不画侧栏，所以不会扣住表单，并补了一格测试钉住。手机上跳到记录页时会丢掉 form 参数，这是原有行为，另开 #32750 跟进。CI 全绿后按队列落地。

## What changes

`@object-ui/app-shell` only. No export, prop or metadata key is added; the new names live in `views/recordDrawerStack.tsx`, which the package entry does not re-export.

- **The drawer reports while it is on its way.** `RecordStackDrawer` (the list's record drawer and the drawer over a record page) registers a token, from a layout effect, while it names a record (`stack.current`) but is not open yet, and drops it in the commit that opens it. The set lives in `AppContent` and reaches the drawers through `RecordDrawerOpeningProvider`.
- **The URL-driven form waits for it.** The `ModalForm` that `AppContent` draws for `?form=` now takes `open` from `useRecordFormOpensOverDrawers(requested, opening)` instead of the bare URL test. The form opens one commit after it is requested (that commit's drawers have reported by then, since child layout effects run before the host's), and only while no drawer is opening. Once open it stays open: a drawer that starts opening under an open form never closes it.
- **…and for the route's element.** `requested` also needs `routeReadsSettled` (the route slot is not its metadata skeleton) and `routeSlotShown`, set by a new `RouteSlotShown` probe that sits after the route's element inside the same `Suspense` boundary. It mounts in the commit that shows the route and is hidden with it, so a route that suspends (or is still a skeleton) before the list and its drawer mount no longer lets the form open first.

The result: on a reload or a shared link the form's dialog is the later body portal and the later Radix layer, so it paints above the sheet and is the layer `Esc` reaches first, exactly as when it is opened by a click.

**Mechanism, measured before the fix** (Playwright, showcase app, 1440×900, `pnpm dev`-style rig: `objectstack dev --fresh` on its own port plus the console's Vite on another): the dispatch's assumption holds. Both layers are body portals at `z-50`; after a reload the body's children were, in order, the form's overlay, the form's dialog, and then the record drawer's sheet. `document.elementFromPoint` at the centre of the form's Create button answered a table header cell inside the drawer, and `Esc` removed `recordId` from the URL (the drawer closed) while the form stayed. A timing probe showed the drawer host mounting in the same commit as the form while the drawer itself opened about 300 ms later, from the list's effect.

**A second cause, found in the live check.** With only the drawer report, 2 of 3 live reloads were still covered: in those runs the drawer host itself mounted about 240 ms after the form had already committed (the route slot was still a skeleton or suspended), so no drawer had reported yet. The `RouteSlotShown` gate closes that.

The mobile arm: on a phone `ObjectView` mounts no record pane at all (`phone ? pageColumn : <ObjectViewRecordOverlay …>`), so no drawer reports and only the route gate applies: the form opens as soon as the page is shown. The only production host of `RecordStackDrawer` is that desktop overlay, and its URL sync calls `navOverlay.open` for every `?recordId=` whatever the object's mode (`useNavigationOverlay.open` sets `isOpen` unconditionally), so no host keeps `current` set with `open` false. The click path is unchanged: the drawer is already open when New is clicked, so nothing is opening and the form opens over it.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordFormOverDrawer-32685.test.tsx`: the real `AppContent` and the real `ModalForm`, under the real `RecordStackDrawer` opened the way the list opens it (from an effect after the list mounts). A layer is "later" when its portal follows the other in the document and when it answers `Esc` first.

- reload shape (`?recordId=a1&form=new&formObject=crm_contact&formLink=account%3Aa1` in one URL): the form's dialog follows the drawer's sheet, its Create button is enabled, and `Esc` closes the form, not the drawer;
- the same when the route suspends before the list and its drawer mount;
- the click path: open the drawer, then add the form params: same stacking, same `Esc`;
- the phone arm (`innerWidth` 390): the same reload URL draws the list and no drawer, and the form opens, not held for a drawer;
- CONTROL: `?form=new` with no drawer opens with no drawer drawn.

<details><summary>Pin run (5/5) and ablations</summary>

```
pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordFormOverDrawer-32685.test.tsx
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

Each ablation through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on a committed head, restore proved by blob equality with HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

1. `AppContent.tsx` `open: recordFormShown` back to `open: isDialogOpen`: the reload cell red (`expected false to be true`, the DOM-order assertion), 1 failed / 3 passed; restored.
2. `recordDrawerStack.tsx` `useReportDrawerOpening(!!current && !open)` to `useReportDrawerOpening(false)`: the reload cell red, 1 failed / 3 passed; restored.
3. `AppContent.tsx` the `routeSlotShown` term dropped from `requested`: the suspend cell red, 1 failed / 3 passed; restored.
4. The test's phone host given a drawer that names the record and never opens (`if (phone) return <RecordStackDrawer … open={false} …/>`): the phone cell red (`expected null not to be null`, no form after 5 s); restored, blob `e493b7ce` == HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Residual boundary, said rather than hidden.** The hold covers drawers that mount with, or before, the route element is shown. A `RecordStackDrawer` that mounts later than that (inside a nested boundary that suspends after the route has shown) would still open over an already-open form; nothing in the console does that today (the list's drawer mounts with `ObjectViewInner`, outside its list's own `Suspense`).
- **Other drawers keyed on `recordId`.** `ObjectDataPage` and `InterfaceListPage` read `?recordId=` for drawers of their own that are not `RecordStackDrawer`; they do not report and are not held for. Not measured whether either can be combined with `?form=` in a URL; not in this card's scope.
- **Phone, measured live** (Playwright `iPhone 13`, 3 reloads of the desktop drawer URL with the form params): no drawer is mounted and none reports (the form is held only for the route gate); the list then answers `?recordId=` by replacing the entry with `record/<id>`, and that navigation carries no search, so the form params are gone and the form closes about half a second after it opened. That drop is `handleNavOverlayNavigate` in `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` (unchanged here, outside this card's file surface); on `main` the same redirect drops the params too (read from the code, not measured live on `main`). Screenshot `issue-32685/phone-reload-redirects-to-record-page-en-iphone13.png`.
- **Every URL form now waits for its page to be shown.** A `?form=` deep link no longer opens over the route's metadata skeleton; it opens in the commit after the route's element is shown. No pin depended on the old timing (the app-shell suite, below).
- **The dispatch's file surface.** `recordDrawerStack.tsx` was declared read-only unless the stacking belongs to the drawer host: the drawer is the one that knows it is on its way, so the report lives there (one hook call in `RecordStackDrawer`, the rest beside it). No `ModalForm`, `components` or `RecordDetailView.tsx` edit; no new prop or export on a published entry, so `Clause-②: no` holds as claimed.
- **Branch name.** The thread's designated branch `claude/project-thread-somtxa`, not `claude/issue-32685-*` (the claim's `Branch:` line names it).

## Verification

Before and after, Playwright on the showcase app (Accounts list, a record drawer, Projects related list, New, then reload), 1440×900, en-US. Screenshots are in the project folder `issue-32685/`:

- `before-1-click-form-above-drawer-en-1440.png`: from a click, the form above the drawer (correct before and after).
- `before-2-reload-drawer-covers-form-en-1440.png`: after a reload, the drawer covers the right half of the form and the Create button.
- `after-2-reload-form-above-drawer-en-1440.png`: after a reload on this branch, the form above the drawer.

| run | head | after reload: body order | Create covered | `Esc` closes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | `6bbdf301` | 3 of 5 runs: form overlay, form dialog, drawer sheet | 3 of 5 covered (the hit lands on a drawer table header) | the drawer in those runs |
| first fix only | `47cc69e9` | 2 of 3 runs: drawer last | 2 of 3 covered | the drawer in those runs |
| this branch | `f49d6104` | 6 of 6 runs: drawer sheet, form overlay, form dialog | 0 of 6; Playwright `click({ trial: true })` on Create passes in all 6 | the form; `recordId` stays |

</details>

Run on `8976d2ef`; the two later commits change only the new test file (types, a module-top import) and one comment, and the new file passes 4/4 on `10133f86` and 5/5 on `0ad90392`.
